evidence.detail: The only exact-v308 external owner is R11 LoginScreen (rs/l/d/c), which constructs multiple rs/l/g instances for textbox, button and box visual controls.
The control hit-tests Client.hP/hQ against the base sprite width/height at the supplied screen coordinates and exposes that hover predicate directly.
It always renders one base rs/l/F sprite and then renders a second rs/l/F sprite with a changing alpha value, switching/fading the overlay according to hover state.
The overlay alpha increases/decreases in configurable steps, with optional frame-delay gating, while the class exposes hover/animation state and current alpha for LoginScreen interaction logic.

LoginScreen uses the same class with assets named textbox/textbox 2, button/button 2 and box/box 2/3, so the semantic role is a reusable login hover-sprite control rather than a specific button or textbox.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the reusable dual-sprite hover/fade control owned by LoginScreen.
